prs.title: Gracefully terminate active sessions during StreamableHTTP shutdown
prs.author: Bortlesboat
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Active SSE stream writers are not closed before session tasks are cancelled during shutdown, causing Uvicorn to log ASGI-incomplete-response errors. Both PRs add writer.close() iteration in terminate() and a graceful shutdown loop in the manager's lifespan finally block. (2 PRs)
prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Active SSE stream writers are not closed before session tasks are cancelled during shutdown, causing Uvicorn to log ASGI-incomplete-response errors. Both PRs add writer.close() iteration in terminate() and a graceful shutdown loop in the manager's lifespan finally block. (2 PRs)
prs.cluster_pick_reason: PR #2259 is a strict superset of #2253: it adds the same SSE writer teardown and manager shutdown logic, and also guards terminate() with `if self._terminated: return` to make it idempotent — preventing double-close if terminate() is called concurrently from both the lifespan shutdown loop and a normal session expiry. PR #2253 lacks this guard, making it subtly unsafe when both code paths race.

clusters.desc: Active SSE stream writers are not closed before session tasks are cancelled during shutdown, causing Uvicorn to log ASGI-incomplete-response errors. Both PRs add writer.close() iteration in terminate() and a graceful shutdown loop in the manager's lifespan finally block. (2 PRs)
